--3 Intense, violent,

--4 (In astr.) Ascendant;

--च्चः The apex of
the orbit of a planet.
--Comp.
--तरुः
{1} the cocoa-nut tree. {2} a lofty
tree in general.
--तालः (heightened)
music, dancing &c. at a tavern.
--देवता time personified, chronos.
--नीच a. {1} high and low. {2} various,
multiform.
--(चं) {1} the upper or lower
stations of planets. {2} change of
accent.
--भाषणं speaking aloud,
vociferous.
--भाषिन् a. shouting,
bawling.
--ललाटा, --टिका a woman
[]
with a high or projecting forehead.
--संश्रय a. occupying a high station
(said of a planet);

उच्चा ind. High, above, upwards,
aloft; ˚चक्र, ˚बुध्न.

उच्चकैः ind.
1 High, above, lofty
(fig. also); श्रितोदयाद्रेरभिसायमुच्चकैः
Śi. 1. 16, 16. 46;

उच्चक्षुस् a.
1 With the eyes
directed upwards, looking upwards;
सर्वा उच्चक्षुषः पश्यंति

.
--2 With
the eyes taken out, blind.

उच्चघनं A secret smile, a laughter
in the mind not expressed in the
countenance.

उच्चट् {c1c} P. To go away,
disappear. --

To scare or drive
away, expel.
--2 To destroy, root
out;

1 Driving away,
expulsion, removal from a place.
--2
Separation.
--3 Eradication,
extirpation (of a plant).
--4 A kind of
charm or magical incantation.
--5
Working this charm, ruining one's
enemy, making a person leave his
business by magical spells by
making him disgusted with it.

1 Pride, arrogance.
--2
Habit, usage.
--3 A kind of garlic.
--4 N. of different plants; गुंजा,
चूडाला भूम्यामलकी, नागरमुस्ता.

.
--2 Quick,
expeditious.
--3 Loud.
--4 Angry, irascible,
violent.
--5 Hanging down.

उच्चंद्रः [उच्छिष्टः चंद्रो यत्र] The last
watch of the night.

To go upwards, to
rise; बाष्पमुच्चरति Mbh.;

.
--2
To ascend (as the sun), issue or
go forth, go up; Śi. 17. 52;

.
--3 To arise, appear forth,
rise (as a voice), to be heard;
उच्चचार निनदोंभसि तस्याः

.
--4 To empty
the body by evacuations, void one's
excrement;
तिरस्कृत्योच्चरेत्काष्ठलोष्टपत्रतृणादिना

.
--5 To emit
(sounds), utter, pronounce; शब्द
उच्चरित एव मामगात्

.
--6 (Used
in the Atm.) (a) To quit, leave. (b) To
sin against, be unfaithful (to a
husband or wife), transgress against;
धर्ममुच्चरते Sk. (c) To violate or
transgress in general, stray or deviate
from;

To cause to issue.
--2 To
utter, pronounce, declare.
--3 To
void one's excrement.
--4 To emit.

1 Going up or out.
--2
Utterance, pronunciation.

उच्चारणं^1
1 Pronunciation,
utterance; वाचः Śik. 2; वेद˚.
--2
Declaration, announcement, enunciation.
--Comp.
--अर्थ a. {1} useful for
pronunciation. {2} necessary for
pronunciation, such as a redundant
letter only used to facilitate
pronunciation.
--ज्ञः a linguist.
--स्थानं the part of the throat from
which certain sounds (such as
nasals, gutturals &c.) issue.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170110. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/334 - comment. note: cf AP..

उच्चरित p. p.
1 Gone up or out,
risen.
--2 Uttered, pronounced &c.
--तं Excrement, fæces.

उच्चारित^1 p. p.
1 Pronounced,
uttered.
--2 Having excrement.

declaration; वर्ण˚, काम˚.
--2

Excrement, dung, fæces; मातुरुच्चार एव सः
H.

.
--3 Discharge
(in general).
--4 Passage (of
heavenly bodies) to another zodiacal
sign or asterism.

To start, set out;
स्थितः स्थितामुच्चलितः प्रयातां

.
--3 To free or extricate oneself
from.

उच्चलित p. p.
1 On the point of
going, setting out.
--2 Gone up or
out; winnowed (as grain).

उच्चावच a. [मयूरव्यंसकादिगण]
1
High and low, uneven,
irregular, undulating;

.
--2
Great and small, variegated,
heterogeneous.
--3 Various, multiform, of
various kinds, diverse; उच्चावचाश्च
पदार्था भवंतीति गार्ग्यः Nir.;

.
--4 Nīvāra rice (collected
by winnowing).
--5 Prosperity,
[]
rise; उच्चयापचयौ

.
--6 The
opposite side of a triangle.
